The Police Sports Association concluded the ninth edition of the Police Jiu-Jitsu Championship, held at the Fatima Bint Mubarak Ladies Sports Academy in Abu Dhabi, with the participation of sectors and departments of the Ministry of Interior and the police general headquarters across the UAE. Abu Dhabi Police claimed first place in the Men’s White and Blue Belt category, followed by Dubai Police in second and Sharjah Police in third. Abu Dhabi Police also secured first place in both the Men’s and Women’s Open Weight divisions, while Dubai Police finished second and the Ministry of Interior team placed third in both categories. The Ministry of Interior delegation was headed by Major General Mohammed Ahmed Al-Ateeq Al-Dosari, Director General of Passports. The meeting discussed several items on its agenda, including the development of passport services, enhancing their quality, and strengthening integration and coordination among member states.
